settings.headline: Nobody built an industry for this seed.
settings.intro: INCHY FORM1 is a sacha inchi nutraceutical designed around satiety — protein and fibre from one Amazonian seed, grown in Colombia by farmers we know by name.
settings.note: U.S. launch soon. The first run is small — the list gets it first.

settings.heading: FORM1 · The pouch · 160 g
settings.copy: Unflavoured sacha inchi powder. One seed's protein and fibre, kept together in one preparation. Stir it into yoghurt, oats, or a drink you already have.

Sacha inchi has 3,000 years of use behind it and no industry around it. No national body. No organised market. A crop can't reward the people who grow it if the market was never built.

So we're building it. A growers association in northeast Colombia. Seed bought direct, from farmers we know by name. A crop formalised — and a reason to plant again next year.

settings.association_answer: Premium sacha inchi doesn't come from a spec sheet. It comes from the right altitude, the right soil and the right farmers. There was no organised market for this crop, so together with growers in northeast Colombia we helped establish an association to formalise it: direct purchasing, consistent quality, a reason to plant.
